jobs.title: Lead Strategy Associate / Strategy Associate
jobs.description:
What part will you play? If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it.
The work we do at Markel gives people the confidence to move forward and seize opportunities, and you’ll find your fit amongst our global community of optimists and problem-solvers. We’re always pushing each other to go further because we believe that when we realize our potential, we can help others reach theirs.

Join us and play your part in something special!

Join Markel at a time of transformation and become part of a high‑impact team shaping enterprise strategy and supporting critical decision‑making!

We’re looking for a Lead Strategy Associate/ Strategy Associate  to join our Richmond‑based Strategy team. In this role, you will report to the Director of Strategy and work closely with the Chief Strategy & Corporate Development Officer. You will partner directly with senior business leaders—including the Insurance CEO, division presidents, and functional heads—to help define Markel’s strategic direction and support execution of key initiatives.

You’ll contribute fresh thinking, structured analysis, and insight to some of the most important questions facing the organization. This is a rare opportunity to gain meaningful exposure across the enterprise while developing strong problem‑solving, financial, and communication skills in a fast‑moving, entrepreneurial environment.

What   You’ll   Be Doing

- Contributing to continuous development of the   overall strategy for Markel Insurance

- Conducting   market research, macro‑trend monitoring, and competitive intelligence   to help keep senior leadership informed on industry developments and competitor activity.

- Supporting business partners on a broad range of business-critical topics, from   product and growth strategies   to operational and organizational challenges and opportunities

- Assisting   in the preparation of   executive‑ready presentations   for the CEO, Executive Leadership Team, Board of Directors, and other senior stakeholders.

- Supporting   corporate development activities ,   including preliminary reviews of acquisition opportunities, market scans, and analytical support across the   deal   lifecycle.

- Helping drive   cross‑functional strategic initiatives , partnering closely with teams across underwriting, operations, finance, and technology.

- Building   strong relationships with business leaders   to support strategy development, challenge assumptions, and bring data‑driven insight to help them grow their business

- Providing   timely ,   accurate   support for   ad‑hoc strategic questions   from the Chief Strategy & Corporate Development Officer, Insurance CEO, and senior executives.

What   We’re   Looking For

- Relevant experience:   2+   years e xperience   in management consulting or similar in-house role (experience in insurance is a plus, not   a   must )

- Problem solving ability:   Strong structured problem-solving skills ,   with the ability to break complex issues into logical components and develop clear recommendations.

- Strong communication   skills : Comfortable engaging with senior leaders,   craft compelling narratives   and able to effectively challenge the status quo to shift the way of thinking

- Team player :   Demonstrated   collaborative ability, both within immediate team and wider company. Ability to   build relationships across functions.

- Ability to   manage multiple workstreams :   Ability to run multiple efforts simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and   ma intain   a   flexible, solutions‑oriented mindset.

- Results-oriented growth mindset : Intellectually curious, goals-driven,   motivated   and   a proactive approach to learning both the insurance industry

- Financial Acumen :   Stron g   financial modeling and analytical skills ,   with high   proficiency   in Excel.

- Education :   Bachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, or   a related   field.

jobs.title: Business Transformation & Data Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Business Transformation & Data Manager (m/f/d)

Looking for a role that will have a meaningful impact on Operations in Spain?

Come and progress your career in our European Operations team here at Markel Spain.

We have an exciting new opportunity for a Business Transformation and Data Manager (m/f/d), based in our Madrid office in the Torre de Cristal.

This role is responsible for leading business transformation, operational excellence, technology-enabled process reengineering improvements, and strategic projects across Southern Europe. The role combines technical expertise and strong operational and business acumen to bridge the gap between Operations, Technology, Data, and Business stakeholders.

This position plays a key role in the implementation of the Southern Europe Target Operating Model (TOM), ensuring scalable processes, data-driven decision making, system integration, and alignment with European strategic initiatives. The role is expected to contribute both from a functional and technical perspective, including data analysis, systems design, automation, and technology governance.

What you’ll be doing:

- Leading business transformation and process excellence initiatives across Southern Europe region, identifying operational improvements, automation opportunities and scalable ways of working.

- Translating business requirements into functional and technical specifications, supporting system integration, automation, testing and implementation activities.

- Coordinating strategic projects across Operations & IT, Finance, Underwriting, Claims and European Data teams, ensuring clear governance, reporting and stakeholder alignment.

- Acting as the primary contact for European Data Engineers & Analysts teams, supporting the development, prioritisation and delivery of scalable data solutions.

- Working with IT colleagues to ensure solutions meet technical standards and are efficiently implemented.

- Applying knowledge of data, SQL, Power BI, Databricks, Excel and Microsoft 365 to support reporting, process improvement and digital productivity initiatives.

- Assessing project proposals, business cases, dependencies, risks and issues, recommending corrective actions where needed.

- Preparing executive presentations, decision papers and project updates to support governance and decision making.

- Monitoring progress, budget, resourcing, third-party contributions, overall delivery performance and lessons learned, ensuring smooth transition to business as usual.

- Developing KPI frameworks, dashboards and management information to support data-driven decision making, operational performance and executive reporting.

Our must-haves:

- Bachelor or Masters’ degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics or a related technical subject area. Equivalent professional experience, supported by relevant technical certifications, will also be considered.

- 5-10 years of experience in Business Analysis, Technology or Transformation functions.
- Experience in insurance, financial services or regulated industries.
- Proven experience working in complex environments and driving business outcomes, leading international and cross-country initiatives.
- Exposure to data migration, cloud transformation and enterprise integration projects.
- Strong analytical skills with a consistent track record of breaking down complex problems. Analytical approach, demonstrating critical thinking and practical problem-solving skills.
- Collaborative style, helping others succeed and building strong collaborator relationships.

- Effective communication skills as you collaborate with local and regional partners, as well as internal colleagues, across Spain and Europe

- Customer-focused approach, with the ability to understand needs and propose effective solutions.

- High standards of quality, ownership and delivery excellence.

- Fluency in Spanish and English. Additional knowledge of Italian, or Portuguese an advantage.
- The legal right to live and work in Spain

What’s in it for you?

- A great starting salary plus annual bonus & strong benefits package
- 27 days paid holiday plus Bank Holidays
- Fantastic company pension scheme, private medical and dental cover, life assurance
- There are countless opportunities to learn new skills and develop in your career and we can provide the support needed to do just that!

Who we are:

Markel Group (NYSE – MKL) a Fortune 500 company with over 60 offices in 20+ countries, is a holding company for insurance, reinsurance, specialist advisory, and investment operations around the world.

We’re all about people | We win together | We strive for better | We enjoy the everyday | We think further

Are you ready to play your part?

If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it. The work we do at Markel gives people the confidence to move forward, reach their full potential and seize opportunities. You’ll find your fit amongst our diverse global community of optimists and problem-solvers. We’re always pushing each other to think further because we believe that when we strive for better and realise our potential, we can help others reach theirs.

Choose ‘Apply Now’ to fill out our short application, so that we can find out more about you.

Markel celebrates the value of a diverse workforce that brings experience and expertise from a wide variety of backgrounds and life circumstances. Whatever your background, if you feel you meet the requirements of this role then we want to hear from you. We are also happy to consider candidates who are looking for flexible working patterns.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The Senior Analyst, National Business Development serves as a strategic partner to the Business Development organization by delivering data-driven insights, process improvements, and technology-enabled solutions that support growth objectives. This role analyzes business trends, identifies opportunities and risks, and translates complex data into actionable recommendations that influence decision-making. The Senior Analyst leads projects from discovery through execution, develops scalable reporting and analytical frameworks, and supports automation, API, and AI-driven initiatives. - Analyst: Understands business needs and provides relevant information and insight to support functional objectives.  Analyzes variables to identify trends, opportunities, issues and risks, and/or probable solutions to problems and situations for specific business areas. Recommends alternative paths forward on projects when necessary. Effectively communicates pros and cons of project alternatives. Demonstrates ability to interpret model results and make connection to expected impact on business.
- Consultant:  Provides expertise, knowledge, and insight to help the business improve their performance and grow by solving problems and finding new and better ways of doing things. Develops team members to build upon strengths and decrease weaknesses in individual performance and maintain positive team dynamics. Acts as a mentor to analysts. Contributes to a positive work environment. Assists in building unity across team.

Responsible for the identification and execution of tasks required by the project plan. Supports department in creation of project deliverables and effectively communicates results to external parties. Caters communication for appropriateness across audiences. Increases accuracy in estimating time and effort to complete assigned tasks.
- Committed to setting and meeting deadlines, even if it requires working longer hours. Checks work for quality and precision without being asked. Actively escalates unforeseen issues with agreed upon path forward.

Intermediate to advanced coding skillset in VBA, PowerBI, Reporting Services, iMacros, and SQL. Able to read in text files or csv, as well as source data directly from relational databases. High level of comfort in utilizing supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
- Takes ownership of work product and personal development.

Qualifications:
- Ability to translate data into clear business insights and recommendations.
- Credibility to engage business leaders in strategic discussions.
- Strong communication and data storytelling skills.
- Analytical mindset and experience with Power BI or similar tools.
- Ability  to connect analytics to business strategy and outcomes.
- Comfort with ambiguity and helping define the right question and answer.

- 5+ years of experience in the insurance or adjacent industry.
- Experience building insights, reports, or dashboards that inform business decisions.

jobs.description:
What part will you play? If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it.
The work we do at Markel gives people the confidence to move forward and seize opportunities, and you’ll find your fit amongst our global community of optimists and problem-solvers. We’re always pushing each other to go further because we believe that when we realize our potential, we can help others reach theirs.

Join us and play your part in something special!

We are seeking an experienced Compensation Partner supporting our US and Bermuda Insurance business. This role will be a member of the HR team and will help ensure the pay programs and structures that support the US and Bermuda business are competitive, equitable, and aligned with our business strategy to help attract and retain top talent globally. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of compensation frameworks, regulatory compliance and ideally the underwriting job family.

Duties and responsibilities
- Serve as the strategic compensation advisor to business leaders, HR Business Partners, and managers by providing guidance on compensation philosophy, market competitiveness, pay decisions, and compensation-related programs.
- Conduct market pricing and compensation benchmarking using multiple survey sources and external market data to develop competitive pay recommendations and support talent decisions.
- Prepare compensation recommendations and analyses for talent actions, including promotions, organizational changes, offer evaluations, and complex compensation decisions.
- Partner with HR Business Partners and business leaders on job evaluation and leveling, ensuring roles are appropriately aligned within the organization's career framework and compensation structures.
- Conduct complex compensation analyses and build compelling presentations that synthesize data, market intelligence, and business context into meaningful insights and recommendations. Present findings to HR and business leaders to support compensation strategy, talent decisions, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness.
- Develop compensation analytics, dashboards, and reporting tools that provide insights into pay competitiveness, workforce trends, and compensation program effectiveness.
- Champion the adoption of new technologies and analytical tools to modernize compensation operations and consulting, improve stakeholder experiences, increase productivity, and deliver data-driven insights at scale.
- Collaborate across HR, Finance, Talent Acquisition, and business leadership teams to ensure compensation programs support business objectives, talent strategies, regulatory compliance, and internal equity.
- Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to harmonize compensation programs, plans, and processes on enterprise-wide initiatives.
- Guide client groups through mid-year and year-end compensation cycles.
- Lead strategic compensation projects across different client groups.
- Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

What you will bring to the role
- At least 8-10 years of progressive experience in Compensation; experience in Underwriting compensation desirable
- At least 5 years experience in business partnering or consulting
- Be able to demonstrate prior experience and understanding of complex total reward compensation plans and awards
- Demonstrate strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to message complex and/or HR process in in a persuasive and pragmatic way

- Able to work independently with the ability to manage a varied range of activities and projects with a positive attitude

jobs.title: National Business Development Account Executive, Canada West
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Sales & Marketing, the Business Development Account Executive (BDAE), Canada West is a key member of the Business Development & Marketing Team (BDMT). The BDAE, Canada West will assist in building a more agile and effective sales and marketing capability that will underpin long-term sustainable and profitable growth for Markel Canada. This role reflects Markel’s increasing focus on the customer and its move away from providing products on a purely transactional basis, toward solution-oriented relationships.
A key member of the Canadian BDMT which oversees and leads Sales & Marketing activities across Markel Canada, the BDAE, Canada West, will work closely with the SVP, Sales & Marketing as other senior Field Leadership Team (FLT) leads to drive the significant growth ambitions for the Canadian market. This will include leveraging data and market insights to proactively identify and target customers and effectively building the customer journey with a focus on customer experience.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Sales & Marketing, the Business Development Account Executive (BDAE), Canada West is a key member of Markel Canada's Business Development & Marketing Team (BDMT). The role is responsible for executing business development and distribution strategies that drive sustainable, profitable growth across Western Canada through strong broker engagement, market intelligence, data-driven opportunity identification, and exceptional customer experiences.
Acting as a trusted advisor to broker partners and an ambassador for the Markel brand, the BDAE plays a critical role in strengthening market presence, generating new business opportunities aligned with Markel's risk appetite, and supporting the organization's long-term growth strategy.

What you'll be doing:

Sales, Distribution and Relationship Management
- Develop and execute territory-based business development plans that support Markel Canada's growth objectives across British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba.
- Build, maintain and strengthen executive-level relationships within a designated portfolio of key broker partners, acting as a trusted advisor and primary Markel representative.
- Conduct regular broker reviews to evaluate relationship health, identify growth opportunities, and support mutual business objectives.
- Actively generate and qualify new business opportunities that align with Markel Canada's underwriting appetite and strategic priorities.
- Partner with underwriting teams to facilitate broker engagement, increase submission flow, and support profitable premium growth.
- Clearly communicate Markel's value proposition, product capabilities, market position, and strategic priorities to internal and external stakeholders.
- Represent Markel at broker meetings, industry conferences, client events, and trade shows to enhance brand awareness and market presence.

Strategic Growth and Market Development
- Leverage market intelligence, portfolio analysis, and customer insights to identify emerging opportunities, growth sectors, and new customer segments.
- Support the development and execution of national sales and marketing initiatives that increase brand awareness and market penetration.
- Collaborate with leadership and product specialists to contribute to strategic planning, distribution segmentation, and growth initiatives.
- Monitor competitive activity and market trends, identifying opportunities to strengthen Markel's market positioning and competitive advantage.

CRM, Pipeline Management and Reporting
- Maintain accurate and timely information within Markel's Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform to support visibility, forecasting, and business planning.
- Manage sales pipeline activity, broker engagement tracking, and opportunity reporting to drive accountability and performance.
- Deliver accurate three-month new business forecasts and provide meaningful insights on broker activity, market conditions, and growth opportunities.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and collaborate with technology and business teams to enhance sales effectiveness and data quality.

Product, Marketing and Business Support
- Partner with marketing and product leaders to develop client-facing sales and marketing materials that support business objectives.
- Ensure broker-facing product information accurately reflects current underwriting appetite, product strategy, and market positioning.
- Support the launch of new products, services, territories, and distribution initiatives across Canada.
- Champion The Markel Style by demonstrating collaboration, accountability, inclusivity, professionalism, and a customer-first mindset in all interactions.

What You Will Bring to the Role

Essential Skills, Knowledge and Experience
The successful candidate will possess:
- Substantial relevant sales, business development, relationship management, or distribution experience within insurance, financial services, or a comparable business-to-business environment.
- Proven success developing strategic client or broker relationships and achieving measurable growth objectives.
- Strong understanding of consultative selling, business development, pipeline management, and customer engagement practices.
- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence effectively at all levels.
- Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make informed business recommendations.
- Experience working with CRM platforms and utilizing data to manage customer relationships and sales opportunities.
- Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders.
- Commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences and embodying Markel's values and culture.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience
- Experience working with commercial insurance broker distribution channels.
- Knowledge of specialty insurance products and underwriting principles.
- Experience developing sales presentations, marketing content, or business proposals.
- Experience with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or similar customer relationship management systems.
- Familiarity with artificial intelligence, digital enablement tools, and data-driven knowledge platforms.

If you're ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you!

Our Values
We're all about people
- Empowering them, supporting them, and helping protect what matters most to them.
- We put people first and stay true to our word because we believe in the power of relationships and doing what's right.

We win together
- We work as a team, exchanging ideas, supporting each other, and respecting everyone's opinion.
- Because together we know we can achieve great things.

We strive for better
- We aspire to lead and win in all that we do.
- Aiming for excellence and finding a better way of doing things is up to us all.

We enjoy the everyday
- We are dedicated to our work, but we always keep a sense of humour and leave our egos at the door.

We think further
- We are committed to building a legacy and making decisions that leave a lasting impact on our customers, partners, employees, and communities.

Additional Information
This role is based in Vancouver, British Columbia, operating within a hybrid work arrangement requiring a minimum of three days per week in the office. Regular travel throughout Western Canada is required, with occasional travel to Toronto and other Canadian locations as business needs dictate.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
Markel celebrates the value of a diverse workforce that brings experience and expertise from a wide variety of backgrounds and life circumstances. Whatever your background, if you feel you meet the requirements of this role then we want to hear from you. We are also supportive of candidates looking for flexible working patterns.

We are committed to ensuring an accessible recruitment process and will provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process where required.

jobs.title: Lead Procurement Analyst, International
jobs.description:
This is a senior role responsible for supporting strategic sourcing initiatives, supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, and procurement optimization efforts across a broad range of spend categories. This role serves as a trusted advisor to the business, partnering across the organization to deliver value through cost savings, supplier performance improvements, risk mitigation, and operational efficiencies.

What part will you play? If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it. The work we do at Markel gives people the confidence to move forward and seize opportunities, and you’ll find your fit amongst our global community of optimists and problem-solvers. We’re always pushing each other to go further because we believe that when we realize our potential, we can help others reach theirs.

Join us and play your part in something special!

The opportunity:

The International Procurement Lead will play an integral role in developing, driving, and supporting Markel International’s indirect spend category strategies valued in excess of £80M in spend.

You will collaborate closely with business leaders, Legal, Finance, Information Security, IT, and external suppliers to support procurement strategies and sourcing activities that align with organizational objectives. We require strong commercial competence, analytical capabilities, and expertise in technology sourcing, contract management, and supplier management.

What you’ll be doing:

- Handle / lead complex strategic sourcing efforts / contract negotiations
- Develop and drive category strategies by partnering with INTL leadership and key business units to develop long term supplier strategies
- Consult with business leaders in identifying business and vendor needs to deliver categories strategies, increase vendor performance, reduce costs and reduce risk.
- Lead key strategic supplier quarterly and annual business reviews
- Strategically mange indirect spend using sourcing processes that engages stakeholders in developing business requirements, aligns business objectives and ensures supplier performance
- Be responsible for the life cycle of strategic suppliers to include but not be limited to: evaluation, selection, and governance to ensure service delivery & quality, relevance, and commercial value
- Develop, align and implement critical metrics in support of handling strategic supplier relationships in line with organizational requirements and processes to achieve exceptional levels of quality and service while maintaining competitive pricing structure
- Conduct market research, supplier assessments, and benchmarking activities to support informed procurement decisions.
- Evaluates supplier risks and ensures appropriate due diligence activities are completed.
- Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure suppliers meet contractual commitments, performance expectations, and business objectives.
- Partner with internal stakeholders to identify and address operational, financial, security, privacy, and regulatory risks associated with third-party relationships.
- Develop business cases and recommendations that balance cost, value, risk, and operational requirements.

Our must-haves:

- International global procurement experience to include knowledge of regulatory requirements
- Experience in negotiating and leading technology agreements, including: (SaaS agreements, Software licensing, Cloud services, Professional services and Statements of Work (SOWs)
- Proficiency in the use of AI-enabled tools and solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, reporting, and procurement processes.
- Project management skills and knowledge of sourcing practices to handle complex projects
- Extensive knowledge of legal contracts and financial disciplines.
- Strong understanding of procurement guidelines, supplier management, and category management principles.
- Knowledge of modern sourcing and procurement systems.
- Proficiency with procurement technologies, reporting tools, and data analysis.
- Ability to handle multiple projects at a time and often under tight timeframes
